text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--The government is studying new plans to promote investments, agriculture and industry.
--EU envoy for peace in the Middle East Moratinos ended his visit to Beirut.
--Syrian President Assad received Lebanon's Parliament Speaker Berri in Damascus.
--Christian Maronite Patriarch Cardinal Sfeir in Brazil: War has ended in Lebanon but peace has not been completely regained.
-The cabinet will discuss in an afternoon session the social and financial crisis in the country. Some demand the government to put an end to the wastage of funds instead of inreasing taxes.
-The Saudi Fund for Development granted Lebanon a $4.8 million to help finance the rebuilding of public schools.
-Australian Deputy Prime Minister Fischer: We are strongly opposed to any settlement (of Palestinians in Lebanon) and the U.N. security council resolution 425 must be implemented.
Lebanese Economy Minister Jaber and Fischer signed an agreement to develop bilateral economic, trade and technical ties.
